summary: Sulu 2nd District representative with 13 principal-authored bills, mostly local roads. Rubric-relevant evidence is co-authorship of the national minimum wage (two versions) and a cash-assistance bill for first-time minimum-wage employees. No other dimension has evidence.
caveat: All rubric-relevant evidence is co-authored; no principal-authored policy bills found. Two names (Arbison, Munir M. and Munir Jr. N.) appear on the House site; this row is the one matching the input name.
